findings.pdf_says: COMMUNICATION SECTION . [ communication-description-entry [ constant-entry / record-description-entry ] ... ] ...   (COMMUNICATION and SECTION underlined; an outer bracket enclosing communication-description-entry and an inner bracket around the stacked constant-entry / record-description-entry alternatives; one ellipsis after the inner bracket, a second after the outer bracket)
findings.why_it_matters: The A.1.1 communication section general format lost both brackets, one of the two ellipses, and the underlining of the required keywords COMMUNICATION SECTION. As transcribed it reads as one mandatory communication-description-entry followed by a repeatable constant-entry, with record-description-entry dangling. The standard makes the whole CD group optional and repeatable, and makes the constant-entry/record-description-entry alternatives optional, one per repetition, and repeatable. Read literally, the transcription rejects an empty communication section and several CD entries in one section, both of which are legal.
